# Third-Party Repositories

Clone third-party projects locally; they are not vendored here.

Expected layout:

```text
third_party/
├── CoralSCOP/
└── sam2/
```

Example:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhengziqiang/CoralSCOP third_party/CoralSCOP
git clone https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2.git third_party/sam2
```

See `THIRD_PARTY_AND_LICENSES.md` before redistribution or commercial use.
